last_episode_to_air.name: A Big Bad Secret!
last_episode_to_air.overview: Ramona Badwolf, daughter of the Big Bad Wolf, gets returns to Ever After High, and resumes her rivalry with Cerise Hood.

name: Ever After High
overview: At Ever After High, the teenage children of famous fairy tale characters choose their own happily ever afters. Everyone from the fairest Royals to Rebel dreamers wonder if the future is fate, or if destiny is just waiting to be rewritten. Are you a Royal or a Rebel?

seasons.name: Specials
seasons.overview: Once upon a High School, in a land beyond imagination, comes the tale of Ever After High. A High School for the next generation of fairytales. Where spellbinding students are destined (or not) to follow in the footsteps of their fairytale parents. But one student, Raven Queen, does not want to follow in her mother's villainous path. What if she wants to choose her own Happily Ever After, and how will it affect other students' destinies, like the Royal leader Apple White? The End, is just the beginning.

seasons.name: Chapter 1
seasons.overview: Following Legacy Day, Raven Queen refuses to sign the Storybook of Legends and chooses to forge her own destiny. As Royals and Rebels adjust to the consequences of her decision, life at Ever After High continues with magical classes, friendships, rivalries, and fairy tale adventures.

seasons.name: Chapter 2
seasons.overview: With Legacy Day behind them, the students of Ever After High face new friendships, romances, school events, and magical mishaps. New faces from Wonderland arrive, and the balance between tradition and choosing your own destiny continues to shape life at school.

seasons.name: Chapter 3
seasons.overview: Ever After High welcomes even more fairy tale students as new adventures unfold. Through magical journeys, personal discoveries, and growing friendships, the students continue to prove that every story can have more than one ending.

seasons.name: Chapter 4
seasons.overview: After the Dragon Games, the students return to everyday life while preparing for Epic Winter. New challenges, magical surprises, and heartfelt moments remind everyone that creating your own happily ever after is the greatest adventure of all.

tagline: The end is just the beginning
